name: PD 267 was established by Ordinance No. 19514, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 8,
source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 267 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 267 was established by Ordinance No. 19514, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 8, 1987. Ordinance No. 19514 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 267 is established on property generally located at the east corner of Melody Lane and Hemlock Avenue. The size of PD 267 is approximately 4.7967 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development of the Property must conform to the development plan (Exhibit 267A). (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.105. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Landscaping of the Property must conform to the development plan. Landscaping must be installed within six months of the date of issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any use on the Property. All landscaping must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.106. PERMITTED USES.

(a) The only uses permitted on the Property are multiple-family and the following limited uses:

(1) Restaurant without drive-in service.

(2) Barber and beauty shop.

(3) Health studio.

(4) Drug store.

(b) All limited uses must meet the requirements contained in Section 51-4.218. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Number Of Units
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.107. MAXIMUM NUMBER OF UNITS.

Maximum number of multiple-family units allowed on the Property is 193. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area For Limited Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.108. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA FOR LIMITED USES.

Maximum permitted floor area for all limited uses combined on the Property is 10,000 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.109. SETBACKS.

A minimum front yard setback of 15 feet and a minimum side yard and rear yard setback of 10 feet must be provided on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.110. MAXIMUM COVERAGE.

Maximum permitted coverage of the Property is 60 percent. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Permitted Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.111. MAXIMUM PERMITTED HEIGHT.

Maximum permitted height on the Property is 36 feet. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.112. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Parking must be provided for each use in accordance with Chapter 51. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Chapter 51. Limited uses may not display any outside signage. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.114. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Utilization of the Property must be in compliance with the requirements of all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.115. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-267.117. ZONING MAP.

PD 267 is located on Zoning Map No. F-8. (Ord. Nos. 19514; 25711)
